verdict.rationale: Provenance signaling is a fair question for an AI video and image generator, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions C2PA, Content Credentials, or a disclosed provenance watermark. The only watermark references are plan perks of "no watermark" (e.g., Starter: "commercial license, no watermark"), which describe removing visible branding rather than providing a provenance signal.

support.subject: As a marketer, generated output carries documented provenance signals (C2PA metadata or a disclosed watermark) I can point to
